description: Honest refinement: the bar-odd arg-sum phase vanishes even with the leading 2-loop (238) c1 correction, and a truncated leading-saddle model reproduces neither phi_odd nor mag_odd_ratio -- so phi_odd is a full exact-Z effect, not the leading 2-loop. Corrects the prior 'entirely 2-loop' attribution; the 1-loop vanishing stands.

data.verdict: HONEST REFINEMENT of the 1-loop-vanishing finding. The bar-odd ARG-SUM phase of the sigma_1/sigma_2 conjugate pair vanishes EXACTLY not only at 1-loop but also with the leading 2-loop (238) c1 correction (c1(σ1)=−Re+iIm, c1(σ2)=+Re+iIm ⇒ arg-sum cancels). And a truncated leading-saddle model reproduces NEITHER phi_odd=-0.004145 (phase 0) NOR mag_odd_ratio=0.0864 at the substrate t (my mag_ratio there = 0.46244). CORRECTION: the prior commit's attribution 'phi_odd generated ENTIRELY by the 2-loop (238) correction' was too strong -- the leading 2-loop arg-sum also vanishes; phi_odd is a genuinely FULL exact-Z effect (cross-saddle interference + higher orders) that only the sibling's 2×2 exact-Z extraction captures. STANDS: the classical (geometric) data carries NO bar-odd datum -- no classical/geometric route reaches phi_odd. No phi_odd value claimed. No fit; no c_k; no tier change.
